name: Alpujarra de la Sierra (Spain)
description: Two equal vertical stripes, green at the hoist and white at the fly with a blue wavy diagonal from the upper hoist to the lower fly, the fly corners green.
history: Alpujarra de la Sierra adopted its arms and flag officially on 7 July 2006; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of two equal vertical stripes, green at the hoist and white at the fly with a blue wavy diagonal stripe from the upper to the lower corner.

features.role: wavy diagonal stripe on the white from the upper corner to the lower fly
green triangles at the upper and lower fly corners
